title: Add the folio chrome to the built site
description: Runs cat-harness's own rail-standalone-pages.ts over the built site in --foreign-site mode, the step folio-assistant's folio-staging.yml runs for a folio's own Pages site. Every page gets the C@T harness rail, the icon row, the Folio glass and the light/dark switch. The rail data is written beside the pages (assets/navbar/rail-<hash>.js); navbar.js/css and docs-ui.js/css load from the platform's published site. Scoped to ihris: sync-docs-harness.ts first regenerates the harness list from this checkout's index.config.json, so the rail lists ihris and the harnesses it needs (no smart-base or smart-trust). It skips a page that already carries a navigation and is idempotent. Needs the platform mounted (src/tools/mount_platform.sh).

invoke.shell: bun run cat-harness/scripts/sync-docs-harness.ts && bun run cat-harness/scripts/rail-standalone-pages.ts --built cat-harness --foreign-site --home-label "iHRIS Knowledge Base" --instance ihris
